# Prompt caching — vocabulary

> Terms of this concept, one per line: canonical name, relation to Prompt caching, definition where a source gives one, and the words people use instead (`aka:`). Read before the index when a term is unfamiliar.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.3.0 · generated 2026-08-31 · 176 units · 2 sources · rights: extractive -->

## Terms

- **prompt caching** · self — Prompt caching — Prompt caching doesn't reduce the number of tokens in context, but it reduces what you pay for them on subsequent requests. If your tool definitions are stable, cache them once and reuse the cached prefix across thousands of requests. · aka: prompt cache, prompt-caching, prompt caches, prompt-cache, cached prompt, cached prompts, caching prompts — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/manage-tool-context#prompt-caching
- **cacheable** · variant · aka: cacheable block, cacheable prefix, cacheable content, non-cacheable, last cacheable block · the docs' adjective for content the prompt cache can hold
- **automatic caching** · hyponym — Automatic caching — Automatic caching is the simplest way to enable prompt caching. Instead of placing `cache_control` on individual content blocks, add a single `cache_control` field at the top level of your request body. · aka: automatic prompt caching, automatic cache, implicit caching, cached automatically, caches automatically, caches the last cacheable block · provider places the cache point (Anthropic auto mode, OpenAI, Gemini implicit) — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#automatic-caching
- **explicit caching** · hyponym · aka: explicit prompt caching, explicit cache, explicit cache breakpoints, block-level caching, manual caching · caller places cache_control breakpoints
- **cache_control** · part — Caching in the Batch API — `cache_control` breakpoints work on Anthropic `:batch` endpoints the same way as on the sync API, but the requests inside a single batch may process concurrently and in any order — a cache written by one line is not guaranteed to be visible to other lines in the same batch · aka: cache-control, cacheControl, cache control, cache\_control, CacheControlEphemeral, cache_control_ephemeral · Anthropic/OpenRouter per-block cache marker — https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/prompt-caching#caching-in-the-batch-api
- **ephemeral cache_control type** · instance · aka: "type": "ephemeral", type: ephemeral, ephemeral cache, ephemeral_5m, ephemeral_1h, CacheControlEphemeral, cache_control_ephemeral · the only cache_control type; bare 'ephemeral' excluded (containers)
- **cache breakpoint** · part · aka: cache breakpoints, breakpoint, breakpoints, cache point, cache points, cache entry, cache entries, 20-block, up to 4 cache
- **cache prefix** · part · aka: cached prefix, prompt prefix, request prefix, hashed request prefix, cacheable prefix, tool-definitions prefix, reusable content, exact prefix · the cache key is the exact request prefix: tools → system → messages
- **cache TTL** · measure · aka: cache TTL, TTL, cache TTLs, time to live, time-to-live, cache duration, cache lifetime, cache expiry, cache expiration, 1-hour cache, 1-hour TTL, 1h TTL, 5-minute cache, 5-minute TTL, 5m TTL, 5-minute default, 1-hour and 5-minute, 1-hour duration, one-hour cache, extended cache, cache refresh, cache refreshes, refreshed on use, refreshes the TTL, longer TTL, shorter TTL
- **minimum cacheable prompt length** · measure · aka: minimum cacheable, minimum token threshold, minimum token thresholds, prompt cache minimum, cache minimum, too short to cache, 512 tokens, 1,024 tokens, 1024 tokens, 2,048 tokens, 2048 tokens, 4,096 tokens, 4096 tokens, minimum prompt length · per-model token floors below which nothing is cached
- **cache hit** · measure — Cache hits drop after changing thinking settings — `cache_read_input_tokens` falls to zero on requests that previously hit the cache. · aka: cache hits, cache miss, cache misses, cache hit rate, cache-hit, cache-miss, hit the cache, hits the cache, did the cache hit — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting#cache-hits-drop-after-changing-thinking-settings
- **cache_read_input_tokens** · measure — Cache hits drop after changing thinking settings — `cache_read_input_tokens` falls to zero on requests that previously hit the cache. · aka: cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_creation, cache_read, cached_tokens, prompt_tokens_details, cache_discount, ephemeral_5m_input_tokens, ephemeral_1h_input_tokens, cache read tokens, cache write tokens, total_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, usage.cache_read_input_tokens, cache read tokens=, Cache read tokens · usage/pricing fields reported per response — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting#cache-hits-drop-after-changing-thinking-settings
- **cache write** · measure — Cache-Write Billing — For GPT-5.6 and later, OpenAI bills cache writes at 1.25x the model's uncached input rate — even with automatic caching, no opt-in required. Cache reads keep the discounted cache-read rate. · aka: cache writes, cache-write, cache creation, writes the cache, written to the cache, write to the cache, writing to the cache, Cache Refreshes — https://openrouter.ai/docs/cookbook/evaluate-and-optimize/model-migrations/gpt-5-6#cache-write-billing
- **cache read** · measure — [Cache read](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching): $1 / MTok · aka: cache reads, cache-read, read from the cache, reads from the cache, reads the cache — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5/overview#pricing
- **cache pricing** · measure · aka: 1.25x, 0.1x, 90% discount, 90% cheaper, MTok, per MTok, Base Input Tokens, uncached input, uncached, cached input, price of cache, cost of cache, cache cost, cache costs, discounts from prompt caching, additional cost, Cache Writes, Cache Hits, cache write pricing, cache read pricing, cache pricing, 5m cache writes, 1h cache writes, stack, stacks · pricing multipliers and table columns; MTok alone is any price table
- **cache invalidation** · problem · aka: invalidates the cache, invalidate the cache, invalidates the prompt cache, invalidate the prompt cache, invalidates the [prompt cache, invalidate the [prompt cache, invalidates your cache, invalidates the entire cache, invalidating the cache, invalidate some or all of the cache, invalidates that level, invalidates the system and messages caches, invalidate caching, invalidates caching, cache is invalidated, breaks the cache, cache break, break caching, breaks caching, bust the cache, cache busting, What invalidates, affects message blocks, affect message blocks, every request is a cache miss · what changes cause the prefix to stop matching
- **cache diagnostics** · part — Data retention — Cache diagnostics is ZDR eligible (qualified). Anthropic does not store the raw text of your prompts or Claude's outputs for this feature. · aka: cache-diagnostics, cache_miss_reason, cache miss reason, diagnostics.previous_message_id, previous_message_id, system_changed, tools_changed, model_changed, messages_changed, diagnostics beta · Anthropic beta that reports why a cache missed — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#data-retention
- **cache pre-warming** · dependent — Pre-warming the cache — Cache pre-warming lets you load your system prompt or tool definitions into the prompt cache before a user triggers a real request. This eliminates the cache-miss latency penalty on the first user interaction, reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) for latency-sensitive applicat · aka: pre-warming, pre-warm, prewarm, warm-up call, warm-up calls, warm the cache, cache warm, max_tokens: 0, max\_tokens: 0, max_tokens=1 workaround, max\_tokens=1 · loading the cache before real traffic — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#pre-warming-the-cache
- **cache-aware rate limits** · dependent · aka: cache-aware, cache-aware ITPM, cache read input tokens do not count, don't count toward ITPM, cache reads don't count · Anthropic: cache reads excluded from input-tokens-per-minute
- **sticky routing** · dependent · aka: provider sticky routing, sticky routing per user, same provider endpoint · OpenRouter: routing follow-up requests to the provider holding the cache
- **cache storage and sharing** · part — Cache storage and sharing — Prompt caching uses [workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/workspaces)-level isolation. Caches are isolated per workspace, ensuring data separation between workspaces within the same organization. · aka: cache storage, workspace-level isolation, isolated per workspace, caches are isolated, cache isolation, cache sharing, share a cache, shared cache · who can hit whose cache — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#cache-storage-and-sharing
- **KV cache** · near-synonym · aka: KV-cache, key-value cache, attention cache · model-internal attention state; prompt caching is the API feature built on it
- **response caching** · contrast · aka: response cache, cached response, cached responses, cache replay, cache replays, X-OpenRouter-Cache, cache_ttl_seconds · OpenRouter feature that replays a whole response for an identical request — not prompt caching
- **Message Batches** · related · aka: Message Batches API, Batch API, batch processing, :batch, compaction, context editing, thinking block clearing, tool search, context management, extended thinking, thinking blocks, thinking block · features whose interaction with the prompt cache the docs describe; never qualifies a unit alone
- **prefix hierarchy** · part · aka: cache hierarchy, tools cache, system cache, messages cache, tools → system → messages, entire cache, lookback window, 20-block lookback, 20-block, cache lookback · tools → system → messages; a change at one level invalidates it and everything after
